facts.fact: A WARDIP Guinea-Bissau post says the government approved the national interoperability regulation (quadro nacional de interoperabilidade), tied to the World Bank-backed WARDIP programme; the post gives no event date, so the published date 2026-08-08 is used.

systems.owner: Government of Guinea-Bissau (announced by WARDIP Guiné-Bissau)

note: No fact on use: the post does not say the regulation is compulsory, names no enforcing body and counts no bodies following it.
